# proxmox_node_ceph_osd_metadata (Data Source)

Reads OSD metadata from `/nodes/{node}/ceph/osd/{osdid}/metadata`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_ceph_osd_metadata" "m" {
  node  = "pve-1"
  osdid = 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `osdid` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `metadata` (String)
